Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AON.
Our gross margin expanded by 165 basis points to 34.3%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Revenue guidance of $4.7 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2019.
We delivered record revenue of $4.7 billion this quarter, representing 6% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $4.7 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. We generated $10.7 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 165 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
